'''January 2005 Fort Worth tournament''' was a ''Star Wars'' CCG local tournament held on Sunday 2 January 2005 at 12:00 PM at Y2Komics, 5270 Trail Lake Drive, Fort Worth, Texas, for the release of [[Virtual Set 8: Jabba's Court|Virtual Set 8]], with [[Mike Richards|Michael Richards]] as tournament director.<ref name="pcf-4308-59058">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=59058#59058 Texas Tournament on 01/02/2005], Michael Richards (mr007agent), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (29 December 2004). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20050217013812/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=59058%26amp Internet Archive]</ref> It was a constructed Swiss tournament with an unlimited card pool, of two or three rounds and no final confrontation, with a $5 entry fee; the announced prizes were two boxes, one of [[Cloud City Limited|Cloud City]] and one of [[Theed Palace]].<ref name="pcf-4308-59058" />

== Format ==

* '''Site:''' Y2Komics, 5270 Trail Lake Drive, Fort Worth, Texas<ref name="pcf-4308-59058" />
* '''Dates:''' 2 January 2005<ref name="pcf-4308-59058" />
* '''Format:''' constructed, unlimited card pool; Swiss, two or three rounds<ref name="pcf-4308-59058" />
* '''Entry:''' $5<ref name="pcf-4308-59058" />
* '''Tournament director:''' [[Mike Richards|Michael Richards]]<ref name="pcf-4308-59058" />

== Results ==

No results were posted in the Players Committee forum topic.
